_comment: Single source of truth for the DPC website/plugin road map. Edit the items below to keep it current; each item has a title, description, and status of 'Completed', 'In Progress', or 'Planned'. The live issue tracker linked on the page holds the day-to-day detail.

items.title: Community Data API
items.description: A backend API (dpc-api) that lets Medieval Factions servers publish faction data to a shared community registry.

items.title: Factions Leaderboard
items.description: A public leaderboard on the website showing community factions synced from participating servers.

items.title: Account Management & API Keys
items.description: Register an account and manage API keys used by plugins to sync data.

items.title: Visit-Counter Reliability
items.description: Crash-tolerant visit storage and a home page that degrades gracefully when the counter is unavailable.

items.title: Automated Test Harness
items.description: A Vitest test suite, run in CI, covering the site's highest-value logic.

items.title: About, Road Map & Commissions Pages
items.description: Informational pages introducing the community, its plans, and custom-development availability.

items.title: News Page
items.description: A news page surfacing community announcements, newest-first, with posts editable on the server at runtime.

items.title: UX & Accessibility Improvements
items.description: A dark/light theme that persists and follows the operating-system preference, current-page navigation highlighting, consistent new-tab external links, keyboard-accessible cards, and in-place error retry on the leaderboard.

items.title: Discord Announcements in News
items.description: Automatically pull announcements from the community Discord server into the News feed alongside hand-written posts.

items.title: Resource Pages
items.description: A page of its own for every plugin, gathering its description, install count, latest release, guide and links in one place instead of a card on the home page.

items.title: Version History & Downloads
items.description: Every release of every plugin, with its changelog and download count, mirrored from GitHub so the site never has to host files itself.

items.title: Plugin Reviews
items.description: Star ratings and written reviews on each plugin, each with a reply from the author, kept separate from bug reports so that a rating is never a support ticket in disguise.

items.title: Plugin Discussion
items.description: Threaded comments on each plugin, kept separate from reviews and from bug reports, with reporting and moderation.

items.title: Update Posts & Watching
items.description: Release announcements written per plugin and syndicated into the News feed, with the option to watch a plugin and be told when it changes.

items.title: Catalogue Discovery
items.description: Tags, categories and Minecraft-version filters so the catalogue stays browsable as it grows.

items.title: Editable Plugin Catalogue
items.description: Allow the plugin cards data to be edited from the website instead of by hand, replacing the checked-in catalogue file with the database table the resource pages are built on.

items.title: TLS via Reverse Proxy
items.description: An nginx reverse proxy in the Docker Compose setup to enable HTTPS.
